verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents one-click virtual card issuance with a limit set per purpose, unlimited corporate cards assigned to the people responsible, and API-issued VCNs whose limit.value can be adjusted later. That covers the virtual-card and per-card spend-limit parts of the story. However, no evidence explicitly shows physical card issuance for team members or how fast it is; the corporate card endpoints only list, block and unblock cards. missing for 10: explicit physical card issuance and its turnaround time, per-employee limit controls on physical cards, independent or hands-on corroboration.
